Drosera rupicola (N.G.Marchant) Lowrie

Genus
Drosera (sundews), family Droseraceae
Subgenus
Ergaleium
Section
Stolonifera

Original description

First described in 1982 as Drosera stolonifera subsp. rupicola:

Drosera stolonifera subsp. rupicola N.G.Marchant, Fl. Australia 8: 384, 43. 1982 [9 Dec 1982]

IPNI record

Given its current name and rank in 2005:

Drosera rupicola (N.G.Marchant) Lowrie, Nuytsia 15(3): 382. 2005 [16 Dec 2005]

Read the original page (Biodiversity Heritage Library) · IPNI record

Range given in the IPNI record of that publication: Australia (W. Australia).

How well the identifier knows it

Of 15 validation photos of Drosera rupicola (photos the model never trained on), its top guess was right for 14. It gave a confident answer for 11 of them, and 11 of those were right.

Only 31 training photos: species with fewer than 40 are identified less reliably.

Most often mistaken for

  • Drosera pallida (1 photo)
